lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in approximately five vertical columns on the visible lateral flank, with each column containing 3 to 5 nodes. The spatial distribution follows a semi-regular grid pattern posterior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the vertical columns of spots, creating high-contrast anchor nodes where the spots reside within the lighter vertical regions.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature displays a sharp vertical gradient, with a high-intensity highlight on the superior edge and a low-intensity shadow on the inferior edge, running parallel to the long axis of the shark on the upper third of the flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 7 to 9 high-luminance blobs are visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, distributed unevenly with higher density towards the leading edge and mid-section of the fin surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Three distinct elongated shapes consistent with remoras are visible: one near the trailing edge of the pectoral fin and two others positioned ventrally to the mid-flank region.
